name: JLC Colorful Silkscreen
description: Export JLCPCB multi-color UV silkscreen Gerbers (.FCTS/.FCBS/.FCBO/.FCBM) from KiCad
description_full: KiCad 8/9/10 Action Plugin that reads Reference Images placed on user layers (or external PNG/JPG artwork), carves out solder mask openings, computes interior alignment marks on any Edge.Cuts polygon, and exports a JLCPCB-ready Gerber ZIP with encrypted multi-color silkscreen layers.
